# Optimization Experiment Reference

The former `optimization_framework/` tree is retained locally under
`demonstration_project/reference_project/`, relative to the repository root. It is Git-ignored,
not bundled with this skill, and absent from fresh checkouts. Its historical results and original
files remain reference evidence; checkout-relative commands and links are not relocation-verified.

Use [AgentCraft process](../agentcraft-process/SKILL.md) for new missions. Inspect and verify a
specific reusable component before adopting it; this archive is not the default execution engine.
Do not run archived setup, deployment or optimization commands merely to discover capabilities.
Discovery grants no model, cloud or application-write authority.
